notes.title: The Trap Shrine Trilogy has reached 150,000 sales!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34565385/116b0027da6a335fb7c0a23813ac4bedf8e23b92.png[/img]
[h3]Thanks to your support, the trilogy of "Trap Shrine" "Trap Legend" and "Trap Genesis" has sold a total of 150,000 copies! [/h3]

Eroge Japan is currently running a sale to celebrate this achievement.
If you haven't played it yet, this is your chance to get them!
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/ErogeJP/
